title: Mousse
hookLine: Satin-smooth spoonable custard with rich caramel notes and dreamy wobble.

steps.title: Set Up Heavy Saucepan & Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Place a heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium-low heat and have a heatproof silicone whisk ready. Measure out {eu82_mlk} and {eu82_egg} and {eu82_sug} and {eu82_flv} in advance—stovetop desserts move fast once they start bubbling.

steps.title: Whisk Custard Silky Over Low Heat
steps.instructionTemplate: Warm {eu82_mlk} and {eu82_sug}, whisk into {eu82_egg}, and cook gently stirring until thick enough to coat the back of a spoon. Gently press the coating onto every side so it adheres evenly, then let excess drip off before transferring to a clean tray.
steps.creatorSecret: Keep heat medium-low and stir continuously so the custard stays satin-smooth.

steps.title: Combine Wet & Dry Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Fold {eu82_sug} and {eu82_flv} into the base in two additions using gentle strokes until glossy and uniform with zero dry pockets. Avoid overmixing so the final texture stays light and tender.

steps.title: Chill 2 Hours & Add Topping
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour into dessert glasses, chill 2 hours, and crown with {eu82_flv} and whipped cream. Plate into 4 generous servings while the flavors and textures are at their peak, and store any leftovers covered.
steps.creatorSecret: Press plastic wrap directly onto the warm custard surface while chilling to prevent a skin from forming.

ugcQuotes.quote: Zero-fluff steps + Cook Mode timer nailed it on the first batch!
